mkm.text: Alquist Proft enters the crime scene at Karlov Manor and introduces himself as the great detective, then deduces that Zegana was posed so the guild seals form a pattern, which includes all ten seals and reveals that a Dimir member is in attendance.

When he confronts Etrata she bares vampire fangs and flees, and after Lavinia demands that the suspect be remanded to Azorius custody, Proft reasons that if Etrata was mind-controlled she is no more culpable than a knife, swears to clear her name and stages a scene over her empty cell as she slips out into the shadows.

Proft finds a fine yellow-gray powder on Etrata's bedside table, is attacked by Massacre Girl until Etrata knocks her away, and concludes that people are being brainwashed into attacks and that the killers are controlled by an outside force.

At the gathering he traps a strange flower in an evidence jar, explains that loss of memory is the connecting thread, shows that the flower is a creation of the Selesnya Conclave, and names Trostani as the mastermind, after which Oba admits she killed the guild leaders because they deserved it.
